title: CloudEventProjection
description: The CloudEvents-compatible projection of an internal EventBus event. Output is a superset of EventEnvelope (CloudEvents 1.0) that ADDITIONALLY requires correlation_id + causation_id (the spine's tracing guarantee that EventEnvelope leaves optional) and carries the source-event provenance (kind + monotonic seq). id is deterministic from (source,type,seq) — never wall-clock. data carries NO raw secrets (redacted on projection).

type.description: the event kind — must be in EVENT_KINDS (single source)
